INSERT INTO messages(
            group_id,
            message_id,
            sender_id,
            type,
            content,
            quotes_message_id,
            created_at,
            ack_by_server
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'text', ?, ?, ?, CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER))
        ON CONFLICT(message_id) DO NOTHING
